note: Request parsing first routes attacker-controlled bytes through the PROXY protocol parser when proxy handling is enabled.
The input begins with the PROXY v2 signature, selecting the version-2 parser.
The raw network buffer is reinterpreted as a PROXY v2 header so fields are read directly from attacker bytes.
The length field from the untrusted header determines how far the parser advances into the buffer.
The parser attempts to bound the claimed header size against the fixed struct size; a malformed length should be rejected if this check holds.
If the parser returns a pointer past the header, subsequent HTTP parsing continues from the attacker-selected offset into the same buffer.
